events.title: Indian Shares Snap Four-day Losing Streak
events.description: Indian shares closed higher on Friday, with benchmark indexes snapping a four-day losing streak, as dovish comments from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller prompted traders to scale back expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase this month.

events.title: U.K. Stocks Subdued Ahead Of U.S. Jobs Data; Construction PMI Misses
events.description: U.K. stocks traded lackluster Friday with the FTSE 100 down 0.03%, as investors awaited U.S. payrolls data for Fed policy signals. UK Construction PMI eased to 44.3 in August, missing the 45.5 forecast, signaling sector weakness.

events.title: French Stocks Mixed In Cautious Trade
events.description: French stocks turned in a mixed performance on Friday as investors made cautious moves, looking ahead to U.S. nonfarm payrolls data for clues on Federal Reserve's interest rate path. Data showing a faster contraction in construction activity in France weighed on sentiment.

events.title: Gold Subdued Ahead Of US Jobs Report
events.description: Gold was subdued on Friday but headed for a modest weekly gain on easing Fed rate-hike expectations.

events.title: Tesla Begins Steering-wheel-free Cybercab Robotaxi Rides In Austin
events.description: Electric-vehicle major Tesla Inc. has started offering Cybercab rides in limited areas of Austin, Texas. The two-seater vehicle comes without a steering wheel or pedals. The exclusive Cybercab launch event was conducted in Austin on Thursday for the golden, butterfly-door cars.

events.title: German Stocks Rise On Volkswagen Restructuring; Factory Orders Beat
events.description: German stocks advanced Friday as Volkswagen surged following board approval of its 'Future Plan 2030' restructuring program. The DAX rose 0.05% to 26,020.97. Factory orders growth and improved construction data supported market gains, though geopolitical tensions and ECB rate hike prospects limited upside.

events.title: Oil Set For Biggest Weekly Gain Since July Amid Rising Supply Risks
events.description: Oil prices fell slightly on Friday but were on track for their largest weekly gain since mid-July amid elevated concerns over supply disruptions.

events.title: European Shares Struggle For Direction Ahead Of US Jobs Data
events.description: European stocks struggled for direction on Friday as focus shifted to the August U.S. nonfarm payrolls report later in the day, which could offer additional clues on the Federal Reserve's policy path.

events.title: Asian Shares Follow Wall Street Higher As Rate-hike Worries Ebb
events.description: Asian stocks followed Wall Street higher on Friday as concerns over U.S. interest-rate hikes eased and focus shifted to the all-important U.S. jobs report later in the day.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises Amid RBA Rate Hike Expectations
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday, as recent Australia's economic data raised the prospect of an interest rate hike by the Reserve Bank of Australia or the RBA as soon as this month.

events.title: NZ Dollar Advances Against Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.description: German automotive major Volkswagen AG announced its plan to cut anouther 50,000 jobs as part of its transformation program 'Future Plan 2030' with 12 initiatives for significant cost savings. The firm would also half its model portfolio by 2035, aiming for more resilient and competitive operations under demanding market conditions.
